cohort: 117 patients with postpartum infections referred to the University Teaching Hospital of Kigali (CHUK) between January 2012 and December 2013
finding: Peritonitis, often resulting from cesarean deliveries, was linked to significant morbidity and mortality, affecting 77% of the patients.
mod_finding: The majority of peritonitis cases were attributed to cesarean deliveries, highlighting a significant association between this mode of delivery and severe maternal morbidity and mortality.
